scope: Prospective PSCAD qualification for the balanced PJM5 fixed-admittance load-step teaching network.

pglib_attribution.attribution: IEEE 2010; source data F. Li and R. Bo, Small Test Systems for Power System Economic Studies

added_load.edge: Post resistance participates at the integer event row (trapezoidal right endpoint).

native_execution.solver_rules: Use trapezoidal integration on the original electrical step, emit each step including time zero, turn off switching interpolation and chatter detection/removal.
native_execution.short_scope: Admit compiled component and measurement roles, then check the original short ramp and all same-step physical equations.
native_execution.long_scope: Admit both full trajectories independently; then check their matched original rows and settled windows.
native_execution.line_terminal_current: Native series branch meter plus its native local shunt meter, with the correct port orientation; retain both ports and series state for each phase.
native_execution.event_exactness: All three extra branch resistances are the same tick-held value; the emitted R_step must equal the frozen Ohms at every row.
native_execution.zero_time_witness: Require original time zero, zero capacitor voltages and zero inductor currents. The directly driven source shunts retain their actual native initial capacitor-current witness for later trapezoidal comparisons.

metric_notes.physical: Check all measured port currents, branch equations and every TR interval. Use absolute cumulative energy and absolute zero-time source-current maxima. Apply the independent same-grid solution on the emitted clock; only the directly driven source shunts use their actual measured zero-time cap-current witness.
metric_notes.settled: Trapezoidal integration of the three-phase native output over the specified 50 ms windows. Use phase-to-ground RMS at bus 2 and three-phase active power from each line into bus 2; test each window against the phasor with the matching load resistance.
metric_notes.cross_grid: Compare common ticks without shifting or interpolation. The two independent TR predictions differ near the right-endpoint load step. Preserve pointwise raw terminal and source differences and qualify them with same-grid physics; apply cross-grid pointwise gates to bus voltages and series currents.
